title: Dr. Brett Cohen agrees the Great Pyramid made sulfuric acid

tellings.quote: He also agrees that the Great Pyramid was producing sulfuric acid, although completely different mechanisms of operation and stages of a reaction.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, who argues that the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt was built as a working chemical machine, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a scientist, Dr. Brett Cohen, agrees with him on one key point. According to Drumm, Cohen also thinks the pyramid was producing sulfuric acid, though Cohen pictures a completely different mechanism and different stages of the reaction. If true, it would mean the pyramid was an industrial device rather than only a tomb.
